name: conflict-split
title: Conflict Split
description: Two materially different review positions are shown with equal visual weight before any explanation of the cause.

use_when: Two materially different evaluations exist around the same review topic
Both sides have enough independent evidence to deserve visible representation
The scene goal is to establish the conflict before explaining it
avoid_when: The conflict is already explained by a known usage condition; prefer condition-split
One side has only anecdotal or insufficient evidence
The scene is actually a simple numeric comparison rather than a review disagreement

notes: Do not imply statistical equivalence merely because both sides are visually balanced
Do not use percentages unless a defensible denominator exists
Quotes must remain traceable to source_ids
At least one evidence item is required on each side
